verdict.stance: keep as a diagnostic only; too early to gate
reasons: Manabe pcol did not flag the known-bad Shine In daily ours (the listener 2/5): pcol 0.0476, below the matching pro (0.075), the official Joe Syntax clip (0.073-0.078), and the admitted-pro median (0.0545). A p95 pcol gate would also have missed it, and would have flagged none of the 50 Mix 08 blends.

Banger clash() is the number that actually lines up with that equal-level complaint: 2/5 ours 0.480 vs matching pro 0.286. It is also the only rated daily where ours clashes more than the pro (the two 4/5 days are 0.111 and 0.076 vs their pros 0.558 and 0.514). The approved long-blend 3.5/5 cut the rate to 0.367; long_fix is still 0.451 (its activity window ran almost the whole clip, so treat that one cautiously).
Continuity somewhat agrees on Shine In (2/5 ours pcty 2.77 vs pro 1.98; the 3.5/5 long cut 2.04). It does not line up as cleanly across the other dailies, and long_fix continuity did not improve.

0/25 r11c and 0/25 long1h blends sit above the pro p95 of pcol (0.108) or of banger clash (0.601). Our mixes are cleaner than the pro median on both collision measures, which is consistent with a phrase-snapped bass swap, but it also means a pro-p95 gate would not have caught the 2/5 Shine In case (banger 0.480 < 0.601).

Deeper -> Just Hold On (mix 03-60 v1, listener: horrible) cannot be rescored: the mix audio and the original Just Hold On stem wav are gone. That failure was a fake 174 grid on a 124 BPM UK-breaks track (R1), which this spectral scorer is not designed to catch.
the listener numeric sample is only three daily ratings (2, 4, 4). Spearman of ours pcol vs rating is -0.87 (right direction) but p=0.33. Do not promote on this sample.
verdict.note: The useful next step is to keep the Banger clash rate and the continuity penalty as diagnostic lanes, gather more the listener-rated blends, and only then consider a gate calibrated to data (never a hand-set threshold). Manabe pcol should not be the gate: it did not separate the known-bad equal-level clash from the pro.
